name: v0.5.0
body:
# Changelog

## [v0.5.0](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/compare/v0.4.0...v0.5.0) (2026-04-14)

### Features

* update README to include `Ctrl-C` as a quit option
([bafc6f6](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/bafc6f6c5eef67d0caca8a03e93dfdf5f30bb960))
* provide helpful message for powermetrics exit codes
([74bec40](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/74bec405f127cf70f419ee1accebb47ebe6813e2))
* add `Ctrl-C` handling to quit application
([dd2594d](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/dd2594d5bc28e78f6cdb523f8a05126e962187bf))

### Fixes

* **ci:** trigger cargo-audit on Cargo.toml changes
([84a02d2](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/84a02d2d310da52c6b551a3303851d1c993b1d3d))
* resolve edition 2024 compilation errors
([b8849a9](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/b8849a93bcf28e04d62ca2a61dc360fe9662fdaa))
* **ci:** fix actions/cache version comments
([eec347d](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/eec347defb4b167880c236e624d1e379c67385ad))
* **ci:** switch to renovate
([dbd2702](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/dbd27024c04521597f1e7ca1153c2a14f1ed9bcc))
* **ui:** avoid underflow in startup screen layout using saturating_sub
([539b620](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/539b6205ccc1b820fac1cf3dc6156b9ab16a9110))
* exit tui and show error message correctly when powermetrics crash (e.g.
running pumas without root)
([c2a4c1b](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/c2a4c1b8046eecc0d69b7da71e34c65e2a725e46))

### Other

* **release:** pumas v0.5.0
([5b491eb](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/5b491ebdb1d191ffbf760add7e22c3e227ec04e6))
* apply cargo fmt for edition 2024
([775b4c5](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/775b4c541d962e0314359bb8c4226afd1b369c74))
* bump to Rust edition 2024 and MSRV 1.88
([b0a175c](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/b0a175cce47d2c4d6d9376fff58d8ffd218eaab6))
* **ci:** adopt better ci
([feeffc0](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/feeffc05bee47f092f763f275cbc6e3d6cf64896))
* **docs:** add rumdl.toml
([6f5ad34](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/6f5ad34d8020e80532dfb503396c762921e86519))
* **docs:** update README.md & src/lib.rs module comments
([a99dd44](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/a99dd441307f8ce05fb0363f374ebcd10deb44dc))
* **soc:** refresh SoC max power ceilings for Apple Silicon
([9bcca84](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/9bcca849a04dc0ba959cc36cb54d64b0e873aeca))
* simplify error handling for powermetrics failures
([1d1c9f3](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/1d1c9f386c8e9a1739d189cfdfecdcbdd8d81870))
* use gh api for version checks, extract outdated to own workflow
([a00a3ef](https://github.com/graelo/pumas/commit/a00a3efa6e2895f6b10e424c7475d31819e4b6cb))
